44629-the-seashore-book-bob-and-betty-s-.title: The Seashore Book Bob And Betty S Summer With Captain Hawes
44629-the-seashore-book-bob-and-betty-s-.creator: Unknown
44629-the-seashore-book-bob-and-betty-s-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. As their first day was fine and the bay smooth, Captain Hawes took the children out for a row in his "sharpey." How delightful it was, skimming so easily over the shining water. The shore, the docks, and the vessels at the wharves were all so interesting from this view.

arxiv-1804-04074.title: A simple random matrix model for the vibrational spectrum of jammed packings
arxiv-1804-04074.creator: E. Stanifer, P.K. Morse, A.A. Middleton, M.L. Manning
arxiv-1804-04074.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by E. Stanifer, P.K. Morse, A.A. Middleton, M.L. Manning. To better understand the surprising low-frequency vibrational modes in structural glasses, we study the spectra of a large ensemble of sparse random matrices where disorder is controlled by the distribution of bond weights and network coordination.

arxiv-2205-07558.title: Evolution of Braneworld Kerr–Newman Naked Singularities
arxiv-2205-07558.creator: Martin Blaschke, Zdeněk Stuchlík, Sudipta Hensh
arxiv-2205-07558.description: Abstract We study evolution of the braneworld Kerr–Newman (K-N) naked singularities, namely their mass M M , spin a a , and tidal charge b b characterizing the role of the bulk space, due to matter in-falling from Keplerian accretion disk. We construct the evolution in two limiting cases applied to the tidal charge.

arxiv-2206-09014.title: Unifying interval maps and branching systems with applications to relative graph C*-algebras
arxiv-2206-09014.creator: C. Correia Ramos, D. Gonçalves, N. Martins, P.R. Pinto
arxiv-2206-09014.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by C. Correia Ramos, D. Gonçalves, N. Martins, P.R. Pinto. We describe Markov interval maps via branching systems and develop the theory of relative branching systems, characterizing when the associated representations of relative graph C*-algebras are faithful. When the Markov interval maps f f have escape sets, we use our results to characterize injectivity of the associated relative graph algebra representations, improving on previous work by the first, third, and fourth authors. Mathematics Subject Classification : Primary 46L05, 37B10; Secondary 37E05.

arxiv-2212-02492.title: Giant Planet Observations in NASA’s Planetary Data System
arxiv-2212-02492.creator: Nancy J. Chanover, James M. Bauer, John J. Blalock \orcidG, Mitchell K. Gordon, Lyle F. Huber \orcidH, Mia J. T. Mace, Lynn D. V. Neakrase \orcidI, Matthew S. Tiscareno, Raymond J. Walker
arxiv-2212-02492.description: Abstract While there have been far fewer missions to the outer Solar System than to the inner Solar System, spacecraft destined for the giant planets have conducted a wide range of fundamental investigations, returning data that continues to reshape our understanding of these complex systems, sometimes decades after the data were acquired.

arxiv-2303-14669.title: Fluctuation of the phase boundary in the six-vertex model with Domain Wall Boundary Conditions: a Monte Carlo study
arxiv-2303-14669.creator: Ivar Lyberg, Vladimir Korepin, Jacopo Viti
arxiv-2303-14669.description: Abstract We consider the six-vertex model with Domain Wall Boundary Conditions in a square lattice of dimension N × N N\times N . Our main interest is the study of the fluctuations of the extremal lattice path about the arctic curves. We address the problem through Monte Carlo simulations.

arxiv-2312-08460.title: Individual chaotic behaviour of the S-stars in the Galactic centre
arxiv-2312-08460.creator: Sam J. Beckers, Colin M. Poppelaars, Veronica S. Ulibarrena, Tjarda C.N. Boekholt and Simon F. Portegies Zwart
arxiv-2312-08460.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sam J. Beckers, Colin M. Poppelaars, Veronica S. Ulibarrena, Tjarda C.N. Boekholt and Simon F. Portegies Zwart. Located at the core of the Galactic Centre, the S-star cluster serves as a remarkable illustration of chaos in dynamical systems. The long-term chaotic behaviour of this system can be studied with gravitational N N -body simulations. By applying a small perturbation to the initial position of star S5, we can compare the evolution of this system to its unperturbed evolution.

arxiv-2404-09393.title: Identification of cardiovascular diseases through ECG classification using wavelet transformation
arxiv-2404-09393.creator: Morteza Maleki, Foad Haeri
arxiv-2404-09393.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Morteza Maleki, Foad Haeri. Cardiovascular diseases are the leading cause of mortality globally, necessitating advancements in diagnostic techniques. This study explores the application of wavelet transformation for classifying electrocardiogram (ECG) signals to identify various cardiovascular conditions. Utilizing the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, we employed both continuous and discrete wavelet transforms to decompose ECG signals into frequency sub-bands, from which we extracted eight statistical features per band.

arxiv-2409-06559.title: Learn2Aggregate: Supervised Generation of Chvátal-Gomory Cuts Using Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2409-06559.creator: Arnaud Deza, Elias B. Khalil, Zhenan Fan, Zirui Zhou, Yong Zhang
arxiv-2409-06559.description: Abstract We present Learn2Aggregate , a machine learning (ML) framework for optimizing the generation of Chvátal-Gomory (CG) cuts in mixed integer linear programming (MILP). The framework trains a graph neural network to classify useful constraints for aggregation in CG cut generation.

arxiv-2410-11751.title: Proof-theoretic Semantics for First-order Logic
arxiv-2410-11751.creator: Alexander V. Gheorghiu
arxiv-2410-11751.description: Abstract . Sandqvist gave a proof-theoretic semantics (P-tS) for classical logic (CL) that explicates the meaning of the connectives without assuming bivalance. Later, he gave a semantics for intuitionistic propositional logic (IPL). While soundness in both cases is proved through standard techniques, the proof completeness for CL is complex and somewhat obscure, but clear and simple for IPL.

arxiv-2502-03327.title: Is In-Context Universality Enough? MLPs are Also Universal In-Context
arxiv-2502-03327.creator: Anastasis Kratsios, Takashi Furuya
arxiv-2502-03327.description: Abstract The success of transformers is often linked to their ability to perform in-context learning. Recent work shows that transformers are universal in context, capable of approximating any real-valued continuous function of a context (a probability measure over 𝒳 ⊆ ℝ d \mathcal{X}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{d} ) and a query x ∈ 𝒳 x\in\mathcal{X} .

arxiv-2502-13670.title: Strichartz estimates for the half Klein-Gordon equation on asymptotically flat backgrounds and applications to cubic Dirac equations Thanks: 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification. M35Q55, 35Q40. Thanks: Key words and phrases. Klein-Gordon equations, phase space transform, Dirac equations, weakly a
arxiv-2502-13670.creator: Sebastian Herr, Seokchang Hong
arxiv-2502-13670.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to establish the L t 2 L^{2}_{t} -endpoint Strichartz estimate for (half) Klein-Gordon equations on a weakly asymptotically flat space-time. As an application we prove small data global well-posedness and scattering for massive cubic Dirac equations in the full subcritical range in this setting.

arxiv-2507-17129.title: Secure Wireless Communication via Polarforming
arxiv-2507-17129.creator: Jingze Ding, Zijian Zhou, Bingli Jiao, Rui Zhang
arxiv-2507-17129.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jingze Ding, Zijian Zhou, Bingli Jiao, Rui Zhang. Polarforming is a promising technique that enables dynamic adjustment of antenna polarization to mitigate depolarization effects commonly encountered during electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation. In this letter, we investigate the polarforming design for secure wireless communication systems, where the base station (BS) is equipped with polarization-reconfigurable antennas (PRAs) and can flexibly adjust the antenna polarization to transmit confidential information to a legitimate user in the presence of an eavesdropper.

Recent trials have shown that a single-dose, triple-drug treatment...

pmc-10712103.title: Effects of anterior approach to quadratus lumborum block on postoperative cognitive function following hip surgery in older people: a randomized controlled clinical trial
pmc-10712103.creator: Manhua Zhu, Yuliu Mei, Ruifen Zhou, Lingzhi Wang, Xiaoyan Zhang
pmc-10712103.description: BackgroundPeripheral nerve block, including the quadratus lumborum block (QLB), has been used for postoperative analgesia in hip surgery. However, the effects of QLB on cognitive function after hip surgery remain unknown. This study aimed to assess the effects of the anterior approach to QLB on postoperative cognitive function in older people undergoing hip surgery.

pmc-11620243.title: Improvement of detector shield in PGNAA facility for boron concentration measurement
pmc-11620243.creator: M Jafari, H Jafari, M H Choopan Dastjerdi, J Mokhtari
pmc-11620243.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A radiation shield consists of borated polyethylene (7 % wt of boron) and lead was used for the HPGe detector in Isfahan MNSR's PGNAA facility in order to remove scattered neutrons and gamma rays, respectively. Therefore, the boron peak in gamma spectroscopy is related to both resources in the sample and in the shield, and it has caused a challenge in determination of boron concentration in the samples.

pmc-12737272.title: Pseudomonas simiae WCS417 and Debaryomyces hansenii Induce Iron Deficiency Responses in Rice (Oryza sativa L.) Through Phytosiderophore Production and Gene Expression Modulation
pmc-12737272.creator: Jorge Núñez-Cano, Francisco J Ruiz-Castilla, Francisco J Romera, José Ramos, Carlos Lucena, Juan Francisco Jimenez-Bremont
pmc-12737272.description: Iron (Fe) is an essential micronutrient for crop productivity, but its low availability in alkaline and calcareous soils limits the growth of rice (Oryza sativa L.), which employs a combined strategy for its acquisition based on the release of phytosiderophores (PS) and the use of specific transporters.

pmc-13114315.title: The Impact of Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) Testing on the Decision-Making Process in Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
pmc-13114315.creator: Roni Gillis, Tamar Zahavi, Nir Peled, Adar Yaacov, Basel Afifi, Jaber Salim, Reham Basheer, Noam Asna, Arnon Makori, Michael Peer, Evgeni Gershman, Yoav Manaster, Osnat Moreh Rahav, Elizabeth Dudnik
pmc-13114315.description: Simple SummaryAfter cancer treatment, tiny amounts of tumor can remain in the body, known as minimal residual disease (MRD). New blood tests can detect fragments of tumor DNA circulating in the bloodstream, potentially revealing hidden cancer before it becomes visible on scans.

pmc-13189829.creator: Raúl Díaz-Pedrero, Oscar Fraile-Martinez, Cielo García-Montero, Diego Liviu Boaru, Patricia De Castro-Martinez, Diego De Leon-Oliva, Laura López-Gonzalez, Beatriz García-González, Isabel Pérez-González, Majd N. Michael Alhaddadin, Silvestra Barrena-Blázquez, Connie Ferrara-Coppola, Ana María Villar-
pmc-13189829.description: Papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) is the most common subtype of thyroid cancer, with a globally increasing incidence. The disease exhibits significant sex-related clinical and biological differences: while incidence is approximately three times higher in women, men face a greater risk of lymph node metastasis, recurrence, and mortality.

pmc-13272071.title: Early multimodal rehabilitation and functional outcomes of a left brachial plexus injury after general anesthesia: a case report
pmc-13272071.creator: Yiru Jiang, Shuqi Hu, Bingjie Yang, Wei Zhang, Song Shu, Hao Zhang
pmc-13272071.description: Brachial plexus injury (BPI) is a common perioperative complication, often caused by intraoperative trauma or improper positioning during surgery. While some BPIs recover spontaneously, many patients experience long-term functional impairments, particularly in the upper limb. This case is distinguished by its focus on a rare perioperative iatrogenic C5–C6 BPI in an adolescent following laparoscopic surgery.

pmc-13449831.title: Parental preferences for immunization advisory clinic settings for children with special health care needs and associated factors in Shanghai: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13449831.creator: Tianxing Feng, Yaqing Xu, Jingjing Li, Yanling Ge, Zhonglin Wang, Danni Zhao, Zhuoying Huang, Mei Zeng
pmc-13449831.description: Children with special health care needs (CSHCN) face persistent immunization inequity despite high overall childhood vaccination coverage. Immunization advisory clinics (IACs) have expanded in China, yet parental preferences for different IAC settings remain poorly understood. This cross-sectional survey was conducted at the IAC of Children’s Hospital of Fudan University, Shanghai, between October and December 2023.
